holdout.description: Persist a compact semantic checkpoint across sessions so future Agents can resume without rereading full history. Many checkpoint fields are also reconstructable from current owner truth, while a smaller subset may contain participant-selected commitments or unresolved identities unavailable anywhere else.
holdout.name: generic-host-checkpoint

holdout.description: Retain two digest-bound scoped HTTPS CONNECT paths beside ambient networking. Ambient already completes all currently tested useful work, while scoped paths can be materially faster on some services and may preserve option value under future ambient failures; they also require dedicated services and qualification.
holdout.name: scoped-egress-paths

holdout.description: Retain a model-visible responsibility ownership/feedback prior learned from earlier Game work and apply it to later rescue behavior. The prior changes how the model reasons about custody and responsibility, but its effect on a later multi-turn objective is indirect and depends on many subsequent policy choices.
holdout.name: game-responsibility-prior

holdout.description: Move exact repeated source-history aggregation out of model reasoning into a deterministic Security-local reducer/projection, then let the model consume that projection. The mechanism targets a precision-sensitive arithmetic burden with a clear owner and exact escape hatch, but the model must still interpret the projection correctly.
holdout.name: security-deterministic-reducer

holdout.description: Retain the production rule that when expression/layout matters, inspect exact rendered pixels rather than treating source/build/browser mechanics as semantic proof. The procedure has a direct observable artifact, a bounded correction path and exact unchanged controls; it is intended for later ordinary Web/Studio production rather than one original page.
holdout.name: render-review-prior

holdout.description: Expose a narrow read-only Workstation network capability/currentness projection after fresh Agents repeatedly reconstruct route affordances from raw configuration. The surface leaves route selection and all effects to the Agent, keeps native evidence reachable, and does not create a central capability registry.
holdout.name: workstation-network-surface

holdout.description: Carry the compact Infrastructure Promotion Rule itself into a later heterogeneous set of architecture/owner decisions as a fixed prompt prior. It adds no new owner facts and may bias different model families differently, but is expected to reduce repeated architecture over-promotion if the historical rule generalizes.
holdout.name: static-meta-selection-prior

holdout.description: Replace the static prior with a generic evidence-calibration procedure that always asks about current consumer, incremental outcome, simpler baseline, recurring cost/coupling, authority fit and reopen/deletion before choosing a disposition. Apply the same checklist to a materially different professional-equipment decision family.
holdout.name: generic-calibration-checklist

labels.NO_CAPITAL: No demonstrated reusable adaptive value; failed/unpromoted/deleted as a general change.
labels.SCOPED_CAPITAL: Useful only at a bounded/local/partial/option-value scope; not demonstrated as broad transferable capital.
labels.TRANSFERRED_CAPITAL: Later independent consumption or repeated responsibility demonstrates reusable adaptive value at a stable evidenced scope.

training.description: A large experimental Agent semantic kernel externalizes identity, state, effect and conformance into one shared reference implementation. Live dogfood shows the prototype can express many desired semantics, but mature operating systems/databases/workflow mechanisms already own much of the mechanics and a shared kernel would become a new authority/compatibility surface.
training.name: semantic-core-v0

training.description: Open semantic work and unresolved external request identity must survive model, Provider, process and Session replacement. Transcript/session-only baselines cannot reliably recover private commitments or unknown external effects after replacement; durable owner state has a clear lifecycle and owner.
training.name: task-continuity

training.description: A proposed temporal cognitive graph externalizes support, contradiction, dependency and supersession relations because chronological transcripts are awkward. Simpler current-source retrieval and typed working-state baselines have not yet failed, and no materially independent consumer requires graph storage or graph authority.
training.name: temporal-cognitive-graph

training.description: Host, Harness and Runtime retain independent authoritative histories, but cross-owner evaluation repeatedly pays manual joining cost. Run-once read-only owner exporters plus a rebuildable selection/query projection reconstruct exact trajectories while owner recovery remains independent of the projection. Multiple owners and formal evaluation consume the same relation semantics.
training.name: observation-minimum

training.description: Evaluation and Security both need to bind material environment/configuration identity, but their payload schemas differ substantially. A Computing composition experiment can preserve each owner record as an opaque immutable binding and compare digests without copying domain fields; a second real non-Evaluation owner composition has not yet demonstrated a shared schema.
training.name: configuration-identity

training.description: Harness owns model/Run usage, Runtime owns physical execution measurements and domains own domain costs. Cross-run comparisons need some normalized numbers, but owner-native measurements can be projected read-only and the numeric fields have different semantics and authority. A global writable usage database would duplicate truth.
training.name: global-usage-authority

training.description: Research repeatedly spends human attention selecting routine next experiments, reconstructing burdens and deciding whether to retain candidate structures. A bounded Agent-led method with frozen oracle, authority boundary, falsifier, deletion and rollback is consumed by the experiment loop and later by Computer self-audit while product/domain promotion stays owner-controlled.
training.name: agent-first-research-method

training.description: Cross-project usefulness repeatedly tempts new shared services. A reusable rule says to inherit mature mechanisms first, then add the smallest owner-local projection, and promote a shared semantic boundary only after repeated unowned stable responsibility; repository/service extraction is a separate later gate. The rule is intended to guide heterogeneous later infrastructure decisions.
training.name: infrastructure-promotion-rule
